# BuzzVideo

> BuzzVideo is an AI ad generator for marketers and creators. Its Marketing Agent turns a product photo, link or idea into campaign-ready video and image ads, using leading models such as Seedance, Kling, Nano Banana and GPT Image in one place.

New accounts get 500 free credits, usable on Seedream 4.5, Seedream 5.0 lite and Seed Audio 1.0; video generation needs a Starter, Pro or Ultra plan. BuzzVideo MCP (https://mcp.buzzvideo.ai/mcp) lets ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients generate videos, images and audio on a BuzzVideo account. Pages marked "coming soon" describe features that are not in the web app yet.

## Ads and agent tools

- [AI Ad Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-ad-generator): Turn a product photo, link or brief into video and image ads for TikTok, Reels and Meta. BuzzVideo's AI ad generator makes every size and new variations.
- [URL to Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/url-to-video): Paste a product page link and get a vertical video ad with a hook, selling points and a call to action. Powered by Wan 3.0 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI UGC Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-ugc-video-generator): Make UGC video ads with a person talking about your product from one photo. Up to 30-second single takes with Kling 4.0 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Product Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-product-video-generator): Make unboxings, demos and hero shots from a product photo. The label stays the same in every shot. Seedance, Kling and Wan on BuzzVideo.
- [Hybrid Reel](https://buzzvideo.ai/hybrid-reel): Turn your own product footage into a vertical ad, with AI-generated shots for anything missing, a voiceover and captions. Hybrid Reel on BuzzVideo.
- [Link to Ad MCP Skill](https://buzzvideo.ai/link-to-ad-mcp-skill): Paste a product page link in ChatGPT or Claude and get ad images and 15-second videos in three angles, with every claim confirmed first, via BuzzVideo MCP.
- [UGC Product Review MCP Skill](https://buzzvideo.ai/ugc-product-review-mcp-skill): Make a creator-style product review video in ChatGPT or Claude via BuzzVideo MCP: an approved script, the same presenter in every clip and captions.
- [Ad Hook Variants MCP Skill](https://buzzvideo.ai/ad-hook-variants-mcp-skill): Keep your ad and swap only its first seconds: new hooks spliced onto the original body and labelled for A/B tests, in ChatGPT or Claude via BuzzVideo MCP.
- [Ad Localizer MCP Skill](https://buzzvideo.ai/ad-localizer-mcp-skill): Turn one finished ad into versions for new languages and markets, with adapted copy, a new voiceover and replaced on-screen text, in ChatGPT or Claude via MCP.
- [AI Marketing Agent](https://buzzvideo.ai/marketing-agent): Brief BuzzVideo's AI Marketing Agent in plain words and get strategy, ad copy and video and image ads in one chat, with the right model picked for each shot.
- [BuzzVideo MCP](https://buzzvideo.ai/mcp): Create videos and images inside ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP-compatible AI chats.

## Video tools

- [AI Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-generator): Generate videos from text or images with Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, Wan 3.0 and MiniMax H3. Compare length and price, then create on BuzzVideo.
- [Text to Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/text-to-video): Write a prompt and get a video clip with motion and sound, up to 30 seconds in one take. Seedance, Kling, Wan and Gemini Omni on BuzzVideo.
- [Image to Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/image-to-video): Upload a photo and turn it into a video clip that keeps your product or character. Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0 and MiniMax H3 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Video Editor](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-editor): Swap backgrounds, outfits or objects in a video with one text instruction. Motion and timing stay the same. Seedance 2.5 on BuzzVideo.
- [Faceless Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/faceless-video-generator): Turn a topic into a faceless video with an AI voiceover, generated visuals and captions for Shorts, TikTok and Reels on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Caption Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-caption-generator): Add captions that stay in sync with the voiceover, in word-by-word and outlined styles, when you build an ad in BuzzVideo's Hybrid Reel editor.
- [AI B-roll Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-b-roll-generator): Generate B-roll clips from a prompt or reference image in any size, up to 30 seconds. Seedance, Kling and Wan on one BuzzVideo account.
- [AI Short Drama Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-short-drama): Turn a premise into vertical micro-drama episodes with a consistent cast, storyboards, dialogue and cliffhangers. Made with AI on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Animation Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-animation-generator): Turn a prompt or image into an animated clip in 3D cartoon, 2D, claymation or paper cut-out style, up to 30 seconds per take on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Anime Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-anime-generator): Make anime-style video clips and images from a prompt, or turn a photo into an anime character and animate it with Seedance, Kling and Wan.
- [AI Dance Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-dance-video): Make any character dance: upload a photo and a dance video and BuzzVideo copies the moves, with clips up to 30 seconds via Kling 3.0 Motion Control.
- [AI Video Extender](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-extender): Continue any clip with AI. Extend forward or backward with Seedance 2.5, or add up to 15 seconds at a time with MiniMax H3 Max on BuzzVideo.
- [First and Last Frame to Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/first-last-frame): Set the opening and closing image and AI generates the motion in between. Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, MiniMax H3 Max and Wan 3.0 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Camera Control](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-camera-control): Upload one image and pick from 13 camera moves, including dolly, pan, tilt and roll. MiniMax H3 Max moves the camera while the scene stays still.
- [AI Storyboard Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-storyboard-generator): Turn a script into a shot-by-shot storyboard with a frame for each shot, then make the approved frames into video on the same BuzzVideo board.
- [AI Video Background Remover](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-background-remover): Generate new video clips with a transparent background, like products, sparkles and smoke. It does not yet remove backgrounds from footage you filmed.
- [Long Video to Shorts](https://buzzvideo.ai/long-video-to-shorts): Turn a livestream, webinar or podcast into vertical shorts: AI picks the best moments, follows the speaker and adds captions and a hook title.
- [AI Dubbing](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-dubbing) (coming soon): AI dubbing that replaces the voice in your video with another language is coming to BuzzVideo. Today, voice a translated script with Seed Audio 1.0.
- [AI Video Translator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-translator) (coming soon): AI video translation for subtitles, on-screen text and voice is coming to BuzzVideo. Today, make voiceovers in 21 languages and lip sync them.
- [AI Music Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-music-video-generator) (coming soon): A music video generator is coming to BuzzVideo. Today, add a track as an audio reference on Seedance 2.5 or Wan 3.0 and generate a clip with it.
- [AI Motion Control](https://buzzvideo.ai/motion-control): Copy the moves from a 2 to 30 second video onto a character in one photo. BuzzVideo's AI motion control runs Kling 3.0 Motion Control and can keep the sound.
- [Video Character Swap](https://buzzvideo.ai/video-character-swap): Replace up to four people in a video with new characters from photos while keeping the motion, camera and scene. Up to 1080p with MiniMax H3 Max on BuzzVideo.
- [3D to Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/3d-to-video): Turn a Blender, Unreal, Cinema 4D or Maya blockout into a realistic video that keeps your camera moves. Up to 15 seconds and 1080p with MiniMax H3 Max.
- [AI Video Upscaler](https://buzzvideo.ai/upscale-video): Upscale video up to 10x or to 4K online. BuzzVideo's AI video upscaler rebuilds detail frame by frame with SeedVR and exports MP4, WEBM, MOV or GIF.
- [3D Studio](https://buzzvideo.ai/3d-studio) (coming soon): Build a scene in 3D, set the subject and camera, then generate the exact shot you framed. Coming soon to BuzzVideo; try the 3D Director MCP skill today.
- [Canvas](https://buzzvideo.ai/canvas): Generate images, video and audio as connected nodes on one board, let the Canvas Agent plan the scenes, and swap any shot without starting over on BuzzVideo.
- [Long to Shorts MCP Skill](https://buzzvideo.ai/long-to-shorts-mcp-skill): Cut a livestream, podcast or webinar into captioned vertical shorts that follow the speaker, right from ChatGPT or Claude with BuzzVideo MCP.
- [Claude Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/claude-video-generator): Claude can't generate realistic video on its own. Connect BuzzVideo MCP and Claude calls Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 and MiniMax H3 to make clips in the chat.
- [ChatGPT Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/chatgpt-video-generator): Add BuzzVideo to ChatGPT, mention @BuzzVideo and describe your ad. BuzzVideo MCP generates the video on its models and returns it to the chat.

## Avatar and lip sync tools

- [AI Spokesperson Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-spokesperson): Make a spokesperson video from a product photo and a script: a presenter or a talking product, with a natural voice, on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Avatar Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/talking-avatar): Turn one photo and a voice track into a talking avatar video with natural lip sync. Kling AI Avatar v2 Pro or MiniMax H3 Max, up to 15 minutes, on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Lip Sync](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-lip-sync): Make anyone in a video say new lines with AI lip sync, from audio or a typed script. Kling LipSync for clips, MiniMax H3 Max up to 15 minutes, on BuzzVideo.

## Image and design tools

- [AI Image Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-image-generator): Generate ad images and product shots from a prompt or reference photos, with your product and label kept intact. Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream.
- [AI Image Editor](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-image-editor): Edit a photo by typing the change: swap props, recolor a product, fix small details or update text while the rest stays the same. Nano Banana and GPT Image.
- [Remove Background](https://buzzvideo.ai/remove-background): Remove the background from a product photo and get a transparent PNG or pure white version for marketplaces and ads on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Product Photography](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-product-photography): Place your real product in any scene from one packshot. The label stays exactly the same. Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Inpainting](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-inpainting): Replace or fix one area of a photo by describing the change. Everything else stays the same. Nano Banana 2.1, Grok Imagine and GPT Image on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Background Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-background-generator): Put a new background behind your product or portrait from a prompt. The subject stays the same. Transparent cutouts with Seedream 5.5 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Image Extender](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-image-extender): Extend a photo to 9:16, 16:9 or any ratio without cropping. New background is filled in to match the original, up to 8:1 banners, on BuzzVideo.
- [Image to Image](https://buzzvideo.ai/image-to-image): Upload a photo and describe the change to get a new image that follows it. Up to 14 reference images with Nano Banana 2.1 and Seedream 4.5 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Photo Relight](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-photo-relight): Change the lighting of a photo by describing it: golden hour, studio or spotlight. The product stays the same. Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream.
- [AI Infographic Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-infographic-generator): Turn product facts or text into an infographic with readable labels and icons. GPT Image for fine print, Nano Banana Pro for text-heavy layouts.
- [AI Photo Restoration](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-photo-restoration): Restore old photos online: upscale small scans up to 4K, sharpen faces and fabric, and clean up dust, scratches and noise with AI on BuzzVideo.
- [Sketch to Image](https://buzzvideo.ai/sketch-to-image): Turn a rough sketch or wireframe into a finished photo, render or illustration that keeps your layout. Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream on BuzzVideo.
- [Consistent Character AI](https://buzzvideo.ai/consistent-character): Keep the same face, hair and outfit across every image and clip. Use up to 14 reference images with Nano Banana 2.1, then animate with MiniMax H3.
- [AI Headshot Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-headshot-generator): Turn a few everyday photos into professional headshots with studio light and a clean background, for LinkedIn and team pages. GPT Image and Nano Banana.
- [AI Mockup Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-mockup-generator): Put your logo or print on realistic T-shirts, mugs, boxes and bottles from a prompt. No template files. Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream on BuzzVideo.
- [Image to 3D](https://buzzvideo.ai/image-to-3d): Turn a photo into a stylized 3D figure with front, side and back views, a box shot and a turntable video. Made for mascots, pets and products.
- [AI Thumbnail Maker for YouTube & Shorts](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-thumbnail-maker): Make 16:9 YouTube thumbnails and 9:16 Shorts covers with bold, readable text from a prompt and your photos, using GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and more.
- [AI Logo Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-logo-generator) (coming soon): BuzzVideo's AI logo generator is coming soon. Today, explore logo ideas from a prompt in the AI Image Generator with GPT Image and Seedream.
- [Remove Object from Photo](https://buzzvideo.ai/remove-object): Brush over people, clutter or stray text and AI removes it, filling the space to match the background. No prompt needed, with a Replace mode on BuzzVideo.
- [Photo Angle Editor](https://buzzvideo.ai/photo-angle-editor): Re-render a product or portrait photo from a new angle: turn up to 90 degrees, tilt, zoom and get up to four views at once with BuzzVideo's Photo Angle Editor.
- [AI Image Upscaler](https://buzzvideo.ai/upscale-image): Upscale images up to 10x or to 4K online. BuzzVideo's AI image upscaler keeps edges, faces and small text sharp, with JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF and HEIC support.
- [AI Virtual Try-On](https://buzzvideo.ai/virtual-try-on): Put any garment on a model from two photos: tops, bottoms or one-pieces, from flat-lay or on-model shots, with Model Swap and up to four results on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Banner Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ad-creative-maker) (coming soon): Turn a brief and your Brand Kit into editable banner ads in every size, coming soon in BuzzVideo's Design Studio. Make banner images in Image Gen today.
- [Brand Kit](https://buzzvideo.ai/brand-kit) (coming soon): Keep logos, colors, fonts and brand voice in one Brand Kit that every BuzzVideo design and AI generation follows. Coming soon with Design Studio.
- [AI Presentation Maker](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-presentation-maker) (coming soon): Turn one sentence into an editable outline and an on-brand slide deck, then present or export to PPTX and PDF. Coming soon in BuzzVideo's Design Studio.

- [AI Graphic Design](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-graphic-design) (coming soon): Turn a brief and your Brand Kit into editable ads, posts and banners, coming soon in BuzzVideo's Design Studio. Make on-brand images in Image Gen today.

- [AI Instagram Post Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-instagram-post-generator) (coming soon): Turn a brief into editable Instagram posts, stories and Reel covers in your brand, coming soon in BuzzVideo's Design Studio. Make Instagram images today.
- [AI Carousel Maker](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-carousel-maker) (coming soon): Turn one topic into an on-brand, multi-slide carousel for Instagram and LinkedIn. Coming soon in BuzzVideo's Design Studio; make each slide in Image Gen today.
- [AI Poster Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-poster-generator): Make event and product posters with readable titles, dates and details from a description, using GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, Nano Banana 2.1 or Seedream 4.5.
- [AI Flyer Maker](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-flyer-maker): Turn a brief into a flyer for an event, sale or opening, with the headline and details spelled right, using GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, Nano Banana 2.1 or Seedream.

## Audio tools

- [AI Voice Over](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-voice-over): Paste your ad script and get natural AI narration placed on your video timeline, in a preset or cloned voice. Seed Audio 1.0 on BuzzVideo.
- [Text to Speech](https://buzzvideo.ai/text-to-speech): Convert text to natural AI speech in 21 languages and download it as MP3 or WAV. Preview a script before you record. Seed Audio 1.0 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Voice Clone](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-voice-clone): Clone a voice from a short sample and use it to read any script as a voiceover. Seed Audio 1.0 on BuzzVideo, more models next release.
- [AI Music Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-music-generator): Describe a mood and tempo and get instrumental background music sized to your ad. Seed Audio 1.0 now, with more music models next on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Sound Effects Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-sound-effects-generator): Describe a sound and get an AI sound effect for your video. Seed Audio 1.0 now; ElevenLabs Sound Effects v3 next on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Song Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-song-generator): Describe a song and get lyrics and music for your ads. Seed Audio 1.0 instrumentals now; sung songs from Lyria 3.5 and ElevenLabs Music next.
- [AI Jingle Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-jingle-generator): Turn your brand name and tagline into a short AI jingle for ad endings. Seed Audio 1.0 now; sung jingles with ElevenLabs Music v2.5 next on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Voice Changer](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-voice-changer) (coming soon): BuzzVideo's AI voice changer is coming soon: hear a recording in another voice. Today, clone a voice with Seed Audio 1.0 and regenerate the script.
- [AI Voice Enhancer](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-voice-enhancer) (coming soon): BuzzVideo's AI voice enhancer is coming soon to remove noise and echo from voiceovers and UGC. Today, re-voice a script with Seed Audio 1.0.
- [AI Podcast Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-podcast-generator) (coming soon): BuzzVideo's AI podcast generator is coming soon. Today, Seed Audio 1.0 voices multi-speaker dialogue in 21 languages from a script you write.
- [AI Lyrics Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-lyrics-generator) (coming soon): A free AI lyrics generator with no sign-up is coming to BuzzVideo: song lyrics from a theme or product, ready to turn into a sung track with Lyria 3.5.

## Models

### Video models

- [Seedance 2.5](https://buzzvideo.ai/models/seedance): Flagship quality for long, premium ads up to 30s.
- [Kling 4.0](https://buzzvideo.ai/kling-4-0): Continuous videos up to 30s with sound.
- [Wan 3.0](https://buzzvideo.ai/wan-3-0): Long 30s single takes with audio for demos.
- [MiniMax H3](https://buzzvideo.ai/minimax-h3): Native audio and lip sync, consistent characters.
- [Seedance 2.0](https://buzzvideo.ai/seedance-2-0): Cinematic hero ads with multi-reference control.
- [Seedance 2.5 Flash](https://buzzvideo.ai/seedance-2-5-flash): Faster Seedance 2.5 for making ads in volume.
- [Seedance 2.0 Fast](https://buzzvideo.ai/seedance-2-0-fast): About 20% cheaper than Seedance 2.0 for quick product and scenery clips.
- [Seedance 2.0 Mini](https://buzzvideo.ai/seedance-2-0-mini): Affordable short clips for social and tests.
- [Kling 3.0](https://buzzvideo.ai/kling-3-0): Multi-shot story ads with dialogue.
- [MiniMax H3 Max](https://buzzvideo.ai/minimax-h3-max): Fast drafts with first- and last-frame control.
- [Wan 3.0 Prime](https://buzzvideo.ai/wan-3-0-prime): Up to 30s with image, video and audio references.
- [Kling 3.0 Omni](https://buzzvideo.ai/kling-3-0-omni): Reference-driven clips and video edits, up to 4K.
- [Vidu Q3 Pro](https://buzzvideo.ai/vidu-q3-pro): Text, image and reference to video up to 16s.
- [Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash](https://buzzvideo.ai/gemini-omni-1-2-flash) (next release): Edit and extend clips up to 15s, with clear on-screen text.
- [Grok Imagine Video 1.5](https://buzzvideo.ai/grok-imagine-video-1-5): Text, image and keyframes to video up to 15s.
- [FLUX 3 Max Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/flux-3-max-video) (next release): Keyframes to video, up to 20s.

- [Kling 4.0 Prompt Guide: One-Take Video Ads](https://buzzvideo.ai/kling-4-0-prompt-guide): Write Kling 4.0 prompts for one-take UGC ads, demos and story ads: character locks, timecoded beats and dialogue, with a template and real Kling 4.0 videos.
- [GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst Prompt Guide](https://buzzvideo.ai/gpt-image-2-5-sunburst-prompt-guide): How to prompt GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst for ad creatives: product references, quoted label text, framing and quality levels, with real Sunburst images.
- [Nano Banana Pro Prompt Guide: Product Ads](https://buzzvideo.ai/nano-banana-pro-prompt-guide): Write Nano Banana Pro prompts for product ads: ad format, product lock, quoted text, pose and lighting, with three real prompts and their images on BuzzVideo.
- [Seedance 2.5 Pricing: Credits per Clip](https://buzzvideo.ai/seedance-2-5-pricing): What Seedance 2.5 costs on BuzzVideo: credits per clip by length and resolution, which plans include it, and how it compares with Kling 4.0 and Wan 3.0.
- [How to Use Kling 4.0: Step-by-Step Guide](https://buzzvideo.ai/kling-4-0-how-to-use): Step-by-step guide to Kling 4.0 on BuzzVideo: open the model, write a one-take prompt, set length, ratio and resolution, then draft before the full clip.
- [Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 4.0: Specs, Price & Picks](https://buzzvideo.ai/seedance-2-5-vs-kling-4-0): Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 4.0 side by side: clip length, references, sound, plans and credit prices, real BuzzVideo results and which to pick for each ad.
- [Seedance 2.5 vs Seedance 2.0: What Changed](https://buzzvideo.ai/seedance-2-5-vs-seedance-2-0): Seedance 2.5 vs Seedance 2.0 compared: 30 vs 15 second clips, references, 4K, plans and credit prices, real BuzzVideo results and when to upgrade.
